title: Jelvan
summary: Free Jelvan by defeating his three linked tormentors with balanced damage.
overview: Split into three teams and keep the tormentors within five health percentage points of one another. Losing balance removes Jelvan's blessing and progressively enables additional attacks.

roles.label: Tanks
tips: Hold one tormentor each inside the encounter area.

roles.label: Damage dealers
tips: Shift damage to the highest-health tormentor to maintain balance.

roles.label: Healers
tips: Expect more incoming spell pressure whenever the groups fall out of balance.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Assign a tank and healing coverage to each tormentor.
Keep the highest and lowest tormentors less than six health percentage points apart to retain the blessing.
Health gaps of 11, 15 and 20 points enable additional spell timers. Correct the imbalance quickly.
Keep the fight inside the arena and avoid a prolonged loss of combat.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
The reviewed source is standard or unversioned; this draft applies to version 0.
